name: C441 Hard or Overweight Landing Check
description: Event-triggered. Reported excessive sink rate or landing above maximum landing weight; also apply ground-load checks if high drag/side loads occurred. Source: 5-50-00 paragraph 3.

name: C441 Overspeed Check
description: Event-triggered. Reported flap/landing-gear placard speed exceedance or VMO 245 KIAS / MMO 0.55 exceedance. Source: 5-50-00 paragraph 4.

name: C441 Landing Gear Blowdown Check
description: Event-triggered. Emergency blowdown bottle discharged or landing gear actuator replaced. Source: 5-50-00 paragraph 5.

name: C441 Severe Turbulence or Maneuvers Check

name: C441 Lightning Strike Check

name: C441 Foreign Object Damage Check

name: C441 Towing Fuel Unbalance or High Ground Loads Check
